buffer_note: H2D left-extruder printable area 325 x 320 x 320 mm minus the requested 3 mm buffer on X and Y and 5 mm on Z (operator rule: print at max height minus 5 mm).

dome.orientation: Lip down on the plate; crown up
dome.notes: One-piece detailed dome with display cutouts; tree supports under the top disc only

body_upper.notes: Upper body ring with integral electronics deck, shoulder bosses, head ring and lazy-susan seat; no brim

body_lower.notes: Lower body ring, skirt, battery bay, centre-leg socket, electronics tray; no brim

leg_upper.notes: Left file supplied; mirror in the slicer for the right leg

leg_lower.notes: Left file supplied; mirror in the slicer for the right leg

foot_outer.notes: Left file supplied; mirror in the slicer for the right foot; two motors and four wheels

leg_center.notes: Revision D centre-leg housing: caster bearings, pitch-hinge nut pockets, heel and toe stop faces

leg_carriage.orientation: Top frame down; tree supports under the cross-web
leg_carriage.notes: Revision D centre-leg carriage: two LM12LUU seats, pitch-hinge cheeks, P16 rod-eye web. Added because the pitch hinge must join the guide bearings, the actuator eye and the housing and no purchased joint does all three

foot_center.notes: Centre foot with caster stem; two motors and four wheels

head_drive.notes: Pivoting friction-drive motor mount with tension screw
